Giver: Right, so we're going from the start all the way to the finish. First, you need to go down just a little bit, past the diamond mine.
Follower: Okay, past the diamond mine. Do I go left or right?
Giver: Left. Keep going down until you hit the graveyard.
Follower: Right, left past the mine, down to the graveyard. Okay, now I'm at the graveyard.
Giver: From the graveyard, turn right. Go up and left until you hit the carved stones.
Follower: Okay, turn right, go up and left... to the carved stones. Got it.
Giver: From the carved stones, go left until you see the great rock on your right.
Follower: Left to the great rock. Okay.
Giver: Now, go down from there. You'll pass the gold mine on your left.
Follower: Down past the gold mine.
Giver: Keep going down a bit more, then turn right towards the trout farm. Stop just before the trout farm.
Follower: Okay, turned right, stopped before the trout farm.
Giver: Now, go down and left. You'll see the cavalry on the right side. Stop there.
Follower: Okay, down and left, past the cavalry.
Giver: From there, go down and right until you hit the cattle stockade on the right.
Follower: Down and right... wait, I don't see the cattle stockade here.
Giver: What? Did you draw a line to the right?
Follower: No, I went left. There's no cattle stockade on the right here.
Giver: Oh. Okay, look at the top right corner. There's a patch of land there. Maybe that's it? No, wait. You're near the indian country. Go down from the cavalry, then turn left towards the great rock at the bottom.
Follower: Okay, down from the cavalry to the great rock at the bottom.
Giver: From that great rock, go left.
Follower: Left... oh, there's a bandit territory on the left. Stop before that.
Giver: Yes, stop before the bandit territory. Then go left again, all the way down to the bottom edge.
Follower: Okay, down to the bottom.
Giver: From the bottom edge, go left until you hit the cattle stockade. Wait, do you have a cattle stockade?
Follower: No, I don't have a cattle stockade.
Giver: Oh, that's weird. Where's the cattle stockade?
Follower: I don't have it. Is it on my map?
Giver: No, it's not on your map. You have to assume it's there. Okay, from the bottom edge, go left a little, then turn up towards the bandit territory.
Follower: Okay, left a bit, up to the bandit territory.
Giver: From the bandit territory, go left.
Follower: Left.
Giver: Keep going left until you hit the parched river bed.
Follower: Left... oh, there's a parched river bed. Stop there.
Giver: From the parched river bed, go down and left to the finish.
Follower: Okay, down and left to the finish.
Giver: And make sure you go past the trout farm on the left and the cavalry on the right.
Follower: Okay, past the trout farm and the cavalry. Done.
Giver: Did you get it?
Follower: Looks like I did.
Giver: Great.
